Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor

Class SnippetsTools

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.texteditor.SnippetsTools
All Implemented Interfaces:
TextEditorExtension
public final class SnippetsTools extends Object implements TextEditorExtension
The bundled "Insert & Snippets" extension (Espresso Phase 6): one-tap insertion of the small boilerplate people constantly retype — a UUID, a timestamp in three flavours, an ISO date, a lorem-ipsum line and a random hex colour. Each snippet is a toolbar button (with a distinct glyph, exercising the SPI's new optional icon) and, when the caret is on a ${name} run, is published as an inline completion so the new CompletionPopup offers it while the user types.

Testability. Every value is produced by a pure static taking an Instant (the no-arg wrappers read the clock), so UUID shape, timestamp formatting, date spelling and the token filter are all unit-testable headless without touching the panel or waiting on a timer.
